Shrimp Vegetable Stir-Fry
Makes 4 servings

1 lb. large shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 tsp. cornstarch
1 Tbsp. canola oil
2 cups snap peas
1 red bell pepper, sliced
1 small onion, sliced
3 Tbsp. oyster sauce
1 Tbsp. rice vinegar
2 cups cooked brown rice

1. Toss the shrimp with the cornstarch.
2. Heat the canola oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the shrimp 2 minutes; remove.
3. Add the snap peas, bell pepper and onion and stir-fry 3 minutes.
4. Return the shrimp, add the oyster sauce and rice vinegar, and toss. Serve over the brown rice.
